context: Kenji and Yuki set up an auto-report system.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: office tech; vocabulary (補助/かける/動作/させる/送ら) in natural home.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 毎日の報告を、自動にできますか?
lines.style: professional office woman voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: システムに、自動で送らせましょう。
lines.en: Let's have the system send them automatically.
lines.style: helpful office man voice, soft warm patient guiding throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 設定に、時間をかけますか?
lines.style: attentive office woman voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 少し時間をかければ、すぐ動作します。
lines.en: With a little time, it'll run right away.
lines.style: clear office man voice, soft warm patient guiding throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 補助の機能も、ありますか?
lines.style: curious office woman voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ええ、補助機能が動作を助けます。
lines.en: Yes, helper functions assist the operation.
lines.style: measured office man voice, soft warm patient guiding throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 自動で送らせると、楽になりますね。
lines.style: satisfied office woman voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 正しく動作させれば、もう安心です。
lines.en: If it runs correctly, you're all set.
lines.style: warm office man voice, soft warm closing throughout
